facts.material: acacia wood (tropical) cutting board; steel strainer, storage bins with lids and support rack
facts.function: food preparation: cutting, straining and holding prepped ingredients
facts.form: two-sided cutting board system with removable steel components

gri_path: GRI 1/2(b): prima facie classifiable in 4419 (kitchenware of wood) and 7323 (household articles of steel)
GRI 3(b): composite good / set for food prep; the acacia wood cutting board, the principal work surface, gives the essential character; the steel strainer, bins and rack are ancillary
GRI 6: 4419.90 other (not bamboo); 4419.90.91.00 other than forks and spoons

rejected_alternatives.reason: steel strainer, bins and rack play a secondary role to the wood cutting surface
those lines are for bamboo; board is acacia wood

missing_facts: Relative value and weight of the steel components versus the wood board (would confirm essential character)
classification.rationale: The cutting board system combines an acacia wood board with removable steel strainer, bins and rack, so it is a composite good or set classified under GRI 3(b). The wood cutting board is the central work surface and gives the essential character, as CBP found for a wood board with an ancillary component in N010808 (in force). As kitchenware of non-bamboo wood other than forks and spoons, it falls in 4419.90.91.00.
